{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I...I can pay you. In fact, if you find my brother as well, I will give you all I have in savings.|Jeridel, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Missing Brother|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Jeridel''' was an individual who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Jeridel and her brother [[Jenson]] both worked in an [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|illegal lab]] on Corellia,<ref name="SWG:MB" /> a lab specialized in [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineering]] creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jenson was promoted as lead [[Beastmaster/Legends|creature handler]]. However, Jeridel's brother failed to return back after three days.<ref name="SWG:MB" /> When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] arrived to investigate the lab,<ref name="SWG:CMAS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Administrative Secrets|Corellia}}</ref> Jeridel hired the spacer to search the laboratory where Jenson worked, to find out what had happened to him. The spacer later returned and informed Jeridel that the brother had been killed by the facility's [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]]. Jeridel paid the individual 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for discovering this information.<ref name="SWG:MB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Jeridel]]
Jeridel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jeridel was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>

Jeridel's species and gender were randomized after each server reset. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Jeridel could appear as included, but were not necessarily limited to, [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]].<ref name="SWG:MB" />
